### `memberData`

The value of a member, read as data. `value` is the value of the member `member` of an object whose computed properties are `payload`: a body in BPScript is none.

```ts
export declare function memberData<S extends ReadonlyArray<object>>(payload: object | undefined, member: string, value: Value | S | undefined): Value | undefined;
```

### `valueFound`

The value in force of a member of `object` that a search finds. That search is the one of `line`, in `collection` (`memberFound`); undefined when it finds none.

```ts
export declare function valueFound<V>(object: { readonly payload: object; readonly members: Readonly<Record<string, V>>; }, line: Category, collection?: Collection): V | undefined;
```
